fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or pinch-point checkpoint at any property access. Site sits within the McCook industrial park; truck yard opens directly onto private/industrial-park streets. Confirmed via 2019, 2025-09 and 2025-10 Street View of the north and west roads.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth structure visible at any access point.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: West building face has a continuous dock line plus a south-facing dock cluster; ~22 doors estimated across both faces from z20 imagery. Pipe rack overhangs the SW apron, partially obscuring count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked along the north edge near the entry road and within the open west yard apron; estimated 16 trailers visible, lot could hold ~35.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very large open paved yard apron on the west and south sides — abundant unused width to add bypass lanes if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Open west/north paved apron functions as on-site trailer storage and drop area separate from the active dock line.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Chicago-metro industrial fabric (McCook), surrounded by large distribution buildings on all sides.
